name: Thokvam: Mulot
source:
The journey to Gaonbura. A furry visual novel inspired in Karbi people and Assam, India. Set in 1993.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250315030934/https://karlsmith.itch.io/thokvam-mulot]Itch.io[/url]]
